Frames decoded from real VP8 encodes of flat slides (pHash regression, B4 review I6):
lecture-* are white lecture slides with a few lines of text at 40 kbit/s; stripes-* are the
first YouTube fixture's slides at 300 kbit/s. Codec refinement moved the median-bit hash up to
4 bits within a lecture slide (6 between two of them) and 26 bits within a stripe slide.
Name: <set>-s<slide>-<seconds>.png.
